PASS_scope: Bounded CODE/TEXT statement of current model input and confirmed context-history limits; not experiment admission or proof of feasibility/impossibility.

evidence: V223 SplitPointPartHead.forward(x,native,other_mask,other_xy) requires float32 x[B,8,96,96]. It evaluates shared(pool(encoder(x))) once, then concatenates shared64 + native onehot8 + other_mask8 + other_xy16. No full-frame tensor, other-query RGB crop tensor, image embedding, ROI, pose, depth or reference argument is present.

V223 trainer constructs rgb from rgb96 rows and valid96, then calls base.assemble_local_input(rgb,valid,use_sam=False). Both fit and saved SOURCE forward paths use this same local assembly and four-argument head API. Checkpoint typing explicitly requires use_sam=False.

V202 SpatialQ8DirectEndHead likewise pools/encodes the local RAW8 input first and adds native/mask/XY only after features64; the name spatial_q8 does not mean pre-pooling RGB spatial attention or full-image context.

q8_condition32.native_onehot8: Original native category; no GT permutation/remap.
q8_condition32.other_mask8: Original availability, with active self slot excluded.
q8_condition32.other_xy16: For available other j, clip((q8[j]-active_q)/active_L,-8,8), F64 arithmetic then FP32; self/unavailable slots zero. Active inputU leaves native onehot and zero mask/XY.
q8_condition32.what_it_can_represent: Point-layout/address/relative scale geometry available from initializer q8/L/availability; it cannot supply pixels of the hidden/missing local part or retrieve another crop by itself.
q8_condition32.no_new_observed_information_claim: Reconstructing adjacency/directions from this same q8 is a representation of already available information, not evidence of new image context or improved performance.

current_model_input.RAW8_channel_internal_reaudit: V181 assembler body not reopened: the permitted V223 contract contains no literal V181 code path. Caller-level local RGB96/valid96/use_sam=False and head input shape are directly verified; no guessed helper path was followed.
